verdict.rationale: Composio's official CLI covers the bookends of the story. It authenticates with `composio login --agent` and installs into agents via `composio setup --target auto`, which adds native plugins for Codex and Claude Code. There is no evidence of CLI commands that stage, build or push a server: MCP server creation is shown only through the SDK (`composio.mcp.create`), not the CLI. Missing for 10: CLI build/stage of a server, CLI push/publish/deploy of a server, an end-to-end documented CLI publish workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents

citations.quote: Use `composio login --agent` to create a Composio agent account and sign in without a browser or a separate email signup.

Install the native plugin for Codex or Claude Code:

composio setup --target auto
The Composio CLI gives coding agents and terminals a local tool surface.
